methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $142M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 4 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.1B - $2.0B.

data.narrative:
XDOF is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $142M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public and 8 private-held firms in robotics and manufacturing at similar or adjacent stages, including Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Walden Robotics.

Two triangulation methods apply. The stage-progression method uses the $142M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, implying a valuation of $284M. The peer-median method examines four same-sector comparables across Series B and Seed stages, yielding a median valuation of $1.7B with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. These peers reflect a wider maturity band, with Series B companies (Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity) valued between $1.6B–$2.0B, and one Seed-stage reference (Walden Robotics) at $1.1B.

Triangulating both methods yields a valuation range of $241M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $992M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around stage positioning relative to peers and the heterogeneity of robotics venture valuations. Key uncertainties include capital deployment velocity, technical differentiation relative to named comparables, and the degree to which Series B peer valuations are appropriate anchors for a Series A asset. Additional data on XDOF's revenue, unit economics, or IP position would narrow this band.
